issues.description: The problem statement shows the state preparation function named _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (with a leading underscore), but both the template and the solution define and expect construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore). This name mismatch between the specification and the provided code can confuse students about which function to implement and may lead to test import/name errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to reference construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore) or rename the function in the template/solution to _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit. Prefer updating the problem text to match the code (construct_zero_state_prep_circuit) to avoid introducing a leading-underscore public API change in the code.
